LinkedIn Cheat-Sheet Infographic

Turn supplied expertise into a save-worthy mobile-first visual guide.

YOUR CUSTOMIZED PROMPT

Design a professional LinkedIn cheat-sheet infographic about [TOPIC] using only the supplied source content. Audience: [AUDIENCE]. Organize it into a bold title, a one-sentence promise and [NUMBER] numbered sections with short headings, concise supporting lines and simple flat icons. Style: editorial grid, [BASE COLOR] with [ACCENT COLOR], generous spacing and strong phone readability. Every factual word must come from the provided content. No invented statistics, decorative filler, tiny text, 3D icons or logos. Output 4:5 at 1080 x 1350.

How to use it

  1. Replace the variables using the fields above.
  2. Copy the completed prompt into Gemini or a compatible model.
  3. Review at full resolution and adjust one decision at a time.
EDITORIAL GUIDANCE

Getting a result you can use

Content visuals need one clear promise, a strong focal point and hierarchy that remains readable on a phone.

Common mistakes

Avoid vague quality words, conflicting styles and large generic negative-prompt lists. State the result, protected details and final placement clearly.

Model behavior changes over time. Review identity, anatomy, text, labels, reflections and rights before publishing.
